newsitem.title: USA: Sun Co may close part of Philadelphia unit.
newsitem.headline: Sun Co may close part of Philadelphia unit.

text.p: Sun Co said Thursday that it may close part of its Philadelphia refining complex next year if financial targets are not met.

Sun Co spokesman Bud Davis said that the manager of the complex, Michael Ruffner, told employees that "if targets are not met (by July 1997) we would consider closing a portion of the Point Breeze refinery."
The Sun complex in Philadelphia has a rated capacity to run 177,000 barrels a day, employs about 1,000 which are divided equally between the Girard Point and Point Breeze units, Davis said.
